# Kiro Log

An honest record of what Kiro produced in this repository and what was corrected by hand.

## Generated by Kiro

- Project scaffold: `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `eslint.config.mjs`, `vitest.config.ts`, `app.json`, `.gitignore`.
- Shared modules in `src/`: types, validation, and helpers used by the backend, catalogue MCP and UI.
- Backend in `backend/`: the app's server-side logic.
- Catalogue MCP server in `mcp/` (`exhume-mcp.mjs`) and its pinning notes (`mcp/PINNED.md`).
- UI in `ui/`: the Crew app front end.
- Agents in `agents/` and the skill in `skills/`.
- Tests: unit and property-based tests written with Vitest.
- Build: `scripts/build.mjs` (esbuild bundles).
- Specs, requirements, design and task list under `.kiro/specs/crew-app/`, and `docs/SPEC_BRIEFS.md`.
- README and this log.

## Fixed by hand

- 2026-11-16, outside Kiro: the lantern glow was made smaller and dimmer (`ui/src/styles.ts`, commit `af56fc9`), since it
  hurt readability and is decoration only.
- 2026-11-16, outside Kiro: re-pinned `mcp/exhume-mcp.mjs` to Exhume commit `47c388a`. After a test on a real
  1989 dBase IV sample disk, where 47 of 86 files came back `NO_CONVERTER`, Exhume gained Lotus 1-2-3 and dBase IV
  memo tables, reads dBase sources as text, and its `exhume` tool copies a file with no converter byte for byte
  as `NAME.EXT.bin`. The Disk_Page marks those copies `(original bytes)` and labels `.WK1` files; one test and the
  spec criterion (crew-app Requirement 9.6) were updated with it.
